title: Mandate
description: Domain view of the delegation that the policy engine reads, AP2-shaped Intent mandate [F12]. Not signed itself: the signed form is the AgentDelegationCredential (mandate-credential.schema.json), logged as MANDATE_SEALED. mandateFromCredential(vc) derives this view: id = vc.id, delegator = vc.issuer, agent = vc.credentialSubject.id, intent_text, rules and parent from credentialSubject, valid_from = vc.validFrom, valid_until = vc.validUntil. R1 verifies the credential proof; R2 reads valid_until. This file also holds the shared primitives ($defs) the other schemas reference. Encodings everywhere: money = integer HKD minor units (cents); time = RFC 3339 UTC with 'Z'; hashes = lowercase hex SHA-256; log and answer signatures = base64url without padding; credential proofs = multibase base58btc.

delegator.description: Person who seals the packet (credential issuer). Signs the credential, revokes and escalation answers.

agent.description: Agent identity this mandate authorises (credentialSubject.id). The planner process holds no key and no card material (I4).

valid_until.description: (R2) vc.validUntil. Mandate and packet end. No card TTL runs past it.

MoneyMinor.description: Integer HKD minor units (cents). No floats anywhere in money.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339, UTC, 'Z' suffix, optional milliseconds. One format so canonical JSON hashes are stable.

DidKey.description: Ed25519 public key as did:key: 'did:key:z' + base58btc(0xed 0x01 || 32-byte key). did:key is no longer in the cut list (D9).

SignatureB64u.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes), base64url without padding. Used by log entries, revocations and escalation answers.

Domain.description: Lowercase merchant host name, no scheme or path.

IntentText.description: Plain-language sentence typed by the delegator (DIR1). Display and judge context only; the engine reads `rules`.

JudgeProvider.description: laya = local default [F11c]; jev = hosted, optional [F11]; replay = recorded answers in the same shape (CI and booth fallback).

ScameterSearched.description: Identifier types searched. Identifier values are never stored.

CompiledRules.description: One field per rule chip in the MandateEditor; carried in credentialSubject.rules. Expiry is the credential's validUntil (mandate.valid_until), not a rule field. Defaults for absent optional fields come from config, which cites the facts register.

budget.description: (R3) Packet size. remaining = budget - committed - spent (see packet-state).

per_purchase.description: (R4) Optional. Effective cap = min over present terms of hard_cap_minor and floor(remaining_minor * share_of_remaining_bp / 10000). Total above ask_above_minor => ESCALATE. Absent => R4 SKIPPED and R3 binds (DM1).

share_of_remaining_bp.description: Adaptive cap in basis points of packet remaining.

categories.description: (R6) Every cart item category must be in this list.

merchants.description: (R6) allow = null means any domain; deny always wins.

seller_check.description: (R9) Scameter state FLAGGED always => DENY. require_capture = true: missing or stale capture => ESCALATE (unverified). 'No record' is not 'safe' [F6].

max_capture_age_s.description: Stale after this age. Default from config [F52].

velocity.description: (R7) Optional override of the default [F32]: more than max_mints approved mints within window_s => DENY.

ParentLink.description: Teen chain only (cut first, D9). Points at the parent-sealed mandate; caps compose: agent <= teen packet <= parent funding. mandate_sha256 = SHA-256 of JCS of the full parent credential, proof included.

Revocation.description: Delegator-signed revoke (S4), payload of MANDATE_REVOKED. signer must equal mandate.delegator. Signature over UTF-8 of 'laisee.revoke.v1:' + hex SHA-256(JCS(this object without signature)).

$comment: examples[0] is SIMULATED: demo mandate M0 (DM1) as derived from the credential example, HK$800 packet [F20], no per-purchase cap, so R3 binds. Keys and dates are placeholders [F59].
